title: Feature manifest (contract v1)
$comment: src/features/<id>/feature.json. A feature is a folder: this manifest, index.js (the feature, run in a private scope), test.js (its own browser test), and optionally feature.css. The build discovers features by scanning src/features/, so adding one edits NO shared file. A feature reaches learner storage only through ctx.store, which allows exactly the keys declared here and writes them to the contract's feature paths (data/users/{uid}/features/{id}/{key}, or under p/{profile}/ for a non-default profile). The folder name must equal id (checked by tools/validate-contracts.js).

tab.$comment: true: shown in the navigation bar. false: reachable only at #f-<id> (reference and internal features)

storage.$comment: every key the feature may read or write through ctx.store; each becomes one document, so keep values small
